judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning and red-test phase, producing only `.lore/dod.md`, spec updates, and a failing acceptance test suite (`src/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). None of the production code changes were implemented: `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `docs/getting-started.md` were left completely untouched. Because the candidate's new acceptance tests expect `transport.history`, `list_conversations`, and `conversation_list` to exist, the test suite fails to compile and pass.
